modules.title: 数据库迁移按版本变更结构的全过程
已有数据时，必填字段要怎样加进去

items.title: 直接加必填约束，旧记录可能不满足
items.text: users 表中的旧记录原本没有 status。直接要求 status NOT NULL，迁移可能因为旧行仍为空而失败；即使数据库允许同时填默认值，也要先确认这个默认值符合业务含义，不能随便猜一个状态。

items.title: 先兼容，再回填，最后收紧
items.text: 第一步先新增允许为空的 status，让新旧版本应用都能继续运行；第二步按明确规则为旧记录回填合法状态，并记录处理行数；第三步确认 NULL 数量为 0，再增加 NOT NULL 约束。

items.title: 用数据结果和新旧应用共同验收
items.text: 同时查看迁移版本、执行日志、回填行数和空值查询；只要仍有 status 为空，就不能收紧约束。还要在测试环境确认旧用户可读取、新用户能写入合法状态，并检查过渡期的新旧应用。迁移记录不是数据备份，破坏性转换前仍要准备恢复方案。

modules.title: 迁移文件不是数据备份
modules.text: 迁移文件保存变更步骤，不保存生产库里的真实数据副本。删列、合并字段等操作可能不可逆；执行前仍要独立备份并演练恢复。应用版本能回滚，也不代表数据库结构和被删除的数据会自动回来。

lessonPractice.title: 准备给已有真实数据的用户表增加一个必填字段 status（不能为空）。最稳妥的工程做法是什么？

options.label: 分步迁移：先加可空字段，按业务规则回填老数据，空值归零后再收紧为必填
options.feedback: 对。先兼容旧记录，再完成数据转换，最后增加约束；每一步都有可检查的结果。

options.label: 直接删掉生产用户表并重新建表，通知所有老用户重新注册并录入个人信息
options.feedback: 不对。重建生产表会删除现有记录，不是增加字段所需的迁移方案。

options.label: 登录生产数据库的可视化管理界面直接点点加列，只要在线上生效就无需提交代码
options.feedback: 不对。只在线上手改无法让其他环境复现，也没有进入项目的版本记录和审核流程。

en.title: You need to add a required column status (NOT NULL) to an existing user table with live data. What is the safest migration strategy?

options.label: Staged migration: add a nullable column first, backfill existing rows, and enforce NOT NULL after verifying zero NULLs
options.feedback: Correct. Keep old rows compatible, complete the data conversion, verify it, and only then enforce the constraint.

options.label: Drop the live user table and recreate it from scratch, asking existing users to sign up and re-enter data
options.feedback: Incorrect. Recreating the production table deletes existing records and is not a migration plan for adding one field.

options.label: Manually add the column via a database GUI in production without checking any migration files into git
options.feedback: Incorrect. A production-only manual edit cannot be reproduced in other environments or reviewed through the project's versioned workflow.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: users 表已经有真实数据，我要新增必填的 status 字段。请先确认项目使用的迁移工具、现有取值和旧版应用是否兼容，再按“先加可空字段、回填合法状态、确认 NULL 数量为 0、最后加 NOT NULL”的顺序生成迁移。先在测试环境执行，并告诉我迁移版本、回填行数、空值检查和旧版读写结果；不要把 down 脚本当成备份。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: The users table already has live rows and needs a required status column. First inspect the migration tool, current values, and old-app compatibility. Then add a nullable column, backfill valid values, verify NULL count is zero, and finally enforce NOT NULL. Run it in staging and report the version, affected rows, NULL check, and old/new app read-write results. Do not treat a down migration as a backup.

learning.assumes: You know databases store business data in tables and columns, and live databases hold real records.
learning.outcome: You can require a compatible-add, backfill, verify, and constrain sequence, then accept it using migration history and data checks.

modules.title: How database migrations safely evolve schema across versions
How to add a required field when rows already exist

items.title: Existing rows may not satisfy a new required constraint
items.text: Old rows in users have no status value. Enforcing status NOT NULL immediately can fail while those rows remain empty. Even if the database supports a default during the change, the value must reflect a real business rule rather than a guess.

items.title: Stay compatible, backfill, then tighten
items.text: First add a nullable status column so old and new application versions can keep running. Next backfill valid values under an explicit rule and record the affected rows. Only after NULL count reaches zero should the migration enforce NOT NULL.

items.title: Verify data results and old/new application behavior
items.text: Check the migration version, log, affected-row count, and remaining NULL values; any NULL means enforcement must wait. In staging, also confirm existing users can be read, new users receive valid status values, and both application versions work during transition. Migration history is not a backup, so destructive changes still need a recovery plan.

modules.title: Migrations are not backups
modules.text: Migration files contain change steps, not a copy of live data. Dropping or merging data can be irreversible, so destructive work still needs an independent backup and a tested recovery path. Rolling back application code does not automatically restore the database.

distinctions.label: Database
distinctions.text: {c:database} is the system that stores persistent data; {c:database-migration} is the versioned script set used to safely evolve that database's structure over time.

distinctions.label: System Rollback
distinctions.text: A {c:database-migration} records how the database evolves; a {c:rollback} returns an application or system to an earlier version. Application rollback does not automatically restore schema or deleted data.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: The users table already has live rows and needs a required status column. First inspect the migration tool, current values, and old-app compatibility. Then create steps to add a nullable column, backfill valid values, verify NULL count is zero, and finally enforce NOT NULL.
